value.text:
fun only? hyps negGoal => do
  let ctx ← Lean.getLCtx
  forIn hyps PUnit.unit fun expr __s => do
      Mathlib.Tactic.Order.collectFactsImp.processExpr✝ expr
      pure (ForInStep.yield PUnit.unit)
  Mathlib.Tactic.Order.collectFactsImp.processExpr✝ negGoal
  if (!only?) = true then do
      forIn ctx PUnit.unit fun ldecl __s =>
          if ldecl.isImplementationDetail = true then pure (ForInStep.yield PUnit.unit)
          else
            have e := ldecl.toExpr;
            if (e == negGoal) = true then pure (ForInStep.yield PUnit.unit)
            else do
              Mathlib.Tactic.Order.collectFactsImp.processExpr✝ e
              pure (ForInStep.yield PUnit.unit)
      pure ()
    else pure ()

signature.text: def Mathlib.Tactic.Order.instToStringAtomicFact : ToString Mathlib.Tactic.Order.AtomicFact

value.text:
{
  toString := fun fa =>
    match fa with
    | Mathlib.Tactic.Order.AtomicFact.eq lhs rhs proof =>
      toString "#" ++ toString lhs ++ toString " = #" ++ toString rhs
    | Mathlib.Tactic.Order.AtomicFact.ne lhs rhs proof =>
      toString "#" ++ toString lhs ++ toString " ≠ #" ++ toString rhs
    | Mathlib.Tactic.Order.AtomicFact.le lhs rhs proof =>
      toString "#" ++ toString lhs ++ toString " ≤ #" ++ toString rhs
    | Mathlib.Tactic.Order.AtomicFact.nle lhs rhs proof =>
      toString "¬ #" ++ toString lhs ++ toString " ≤ #" ++ toString rhs
    | Mathlib.Tactic.Order.AtomicFact.lt lhs rhs proof =>
      toString "#" ++ toString lhs ++ toString " < #" ++ toString rhs
    | Mathlib.Tactic.Order.AtomicFact.nlt lhs rhs proof =>
      toString "¬ #" ++ toString lhs ++ toString " < #" ++ toString rhs
    | Mathlib.Tactic.Order.AtomicFact.isTop idx => toString "#" ++ toString idx ++ toString " := ⊤"
    | Mathlib.Tactic.Order.AtomicFact.isBot idx => toString "#" ++ toString idx ++ toString " := ⊥"
    | Mathlib.Tactic.Order.AtomicFact.isInf lhs rhs res =>
      toString "#" ++ toString res ++ toString " := #" ++ toString lhs ++ toString " ⊓ #" ++
        toString rhs
    | Mathlib.Tactic.Order.AtomicFact.isSup lhs rhs res =>
      toString "#" ++ toString res ++ toString " := #" ++ toString lhs ++ toString " ⊔ #" ++
        toString rhs }

doc:
`order` solves the main goal if it can be derived from the local hypotheses and the axioms of
`Preorder`, `PartialOrder` or `LinearOrder`. Also supports `⊤`, `⊥` and lattice operations.

This tactic fails if it cannot prove the main goal.

* `order [e₁, ..., eₙ]` uses the terms `e₁`, ... `eₙ` as hypotheses, in addition to the local
  context.
* `order only [e₁, ..., eₙ]` uses only the terms `e₁`, ... `eₙ` as hypotheses (ignoring the local
  context).

doc:
`liftOfRightInverse f hf g hg` is the unique ring homomorphism `φ`

* such that `φ.comp f = g` (`RingHom.liftOfRightInverse_comp`),
* where `f : A →+* B` has a right inverse `f_inv` (`hf`),
* and `g : B →+* C` satisfies `hg : f.ker ≤ g.ker`.

See `RingHom.eq_liftOfRightInverse` for the uniqueness lemma.

```
   A .
   |  \
 f |   \ g
   |    \
   v     \⌟
   B ----> C
      ∃!φ
```
